edge_block_derivation: Let x=h tensor delta and y=t tensor S^*delta for the common residual suffix transport S.
The Hermitian edge-block difference between transposition and identity is -2(x y^*+y x^*).
With c_1=x-y=L_-(delta) and c_0=x+y=L_+(delta), c_1 c_1^*-c_0 c_0^*=-2(x y^*+y x^*).
Hence there is one common middle M_mid with M_trans=M_mid+c_1 c_1^* and M_id=M_mid+c_0 c_0^*.
Therefore in K=zI-M convention, K_trans=K_mid-c_1 c_1^* and K_id=K_mid-c_0 c_0^*.
